Name: Trenitalia
Company description: Trenitalia, the Ferrovie dello Stato Group's company for the transportation of passengers and the provision of logistics services for goods, is one of Europe’s largest rail operators. Trenitalia's mission is to provide services, in a domestic and European context, able to satisfy demand for the mobility of travellers and the transportation of goods.

Name: Trenord
Company description: Trenord is a prominent railway company operating in Lombardy, Italy, specializing in regional, suburban, and airport train services. Established in 2011 as a joint venture between Trenitalia and Ferrovie Nord Milano, Trenord is dedicated to enhancing mobility and sustainability across the region. The company operates an extensive network of over 2,200 daily train services, connecting major cities and towns, including direct routes to Malpensa Airport, and serving approximately 190 million passengers annually. Trenord's mission focuses on providing efficient, reliable, and accessible transportation solutions while promoting environmental responsibility and customer satisfaction. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including daily commuters, tourists, and individuals with disabilities, ensuring that all passengers can travel comfortably and conveniently. Trenord offers various ticketing options, including integrated tickets, season passes, and special concessions for families and seniors, making it easier for users to access its services. Collaborating closely with local authorities and transport agencies, Trenord aims to create seamless travel experiences and improve service quality across its network. Trenord is committed to sustainability, actively working to reduce its environmental impact through initiatives that align with the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals. The company emphasizes modernizing its fleet and infrastructure, including the introduction of hydrogen-powered trains, to meet the evolving needs of its users. Trenord also engages in community support initiatives, partnering with local organizations to promote sustainable travel and enhance regional tourism. With a workforce of approximately 4,720 employees, Trenord fosters a culture of safety, health, and continuous improvement, striving to be a leader in the railway sector while contributing positively to the communities it serves. Through its innovative projects and commitment to operational excellence, Trenord aims to enhance the overall travel experience for all its passengers, positioning itself as a cornerstone of the Lombard mobility system.

Name: EAV Ente Autonomo Volturno
Company description: EAV Ente Autonomo Volturno is a public transportation company based in Campania, Italy, specializing in the operation of bus and rail services. The company is committed to modernizing its fleet, as evidenced by its recent acquisition of six new buses, bringing its total to 198 out of a planned 365 operational vehicles. EAV's mission focuses on enhancing public transport accessibility and sustainability, with future plans to introduce 150 additional buses, including 60 electric models, as part of a regional modernization initiative. The company serves a diverse clientele, including daily commuters and tourists, and collaborates with regional authorities to improve transportation infrastructure and services in the area. EAV aims to provide reliable and efficient transport solutions, contributing to the overall development of the region's mobility landscape.

Name: Ferrovie Dello Stato Italiane S.p.A.
Company description: Ferrovie Dello Stato Italiane S.p.A. (FS Italiane) is Italy's primary railway company, responsible for managing and operating the national railway infrastructure and providing comprehensive passenger and freight transport services. Established in 1905, FS Italiane has played a pivotal role in shaping Italy's transportation landscape, focusing on enhancing mobility and connectivity across the country. The company's mission is to promote sustainable and efficient transport solutions while ensuring safety, comfort, and innovation in its operations. FS Italiane serves a diverse clientele, including individual passengers, businesses, and public institutions, and collaborates with various partners, including regional governments and international transport organizations, to improve service quality and expand its network. The company operates through several specialized subsidiaries, including Trenitalia for passenger services and Mercitalia for freight transport, allowing it to cater to a wide range of customer needs. FS Italiane is committed to sustainability, aiming for net-zero emissions by 2040 and actively investing in renewable energy and eco-friendly technologies. Its vision emphasizes the importance of integrating rail services with urban development, transforming railway stations into community hubs that enhance local economies and promote social inclusion. Through strategic initiatives and significant investments in infrastructure, FS Italiane seeks to lead the transition towards a greener transport system, contributing to the economic and social development of Italy. The company is dedicated to fostering a culture of safety and continuous improvement, ensuring high standards of service delivery while addressing the challenges of climate change and urbanization. With a workforce of over 96,000 employees, FS Italiane is positioned as a key player in the European transport sector, striving to enhance the overall travel experience for its users and support the sustainable development of the regions it serves.

Name: TPER SPA
Company description: TPER S.p.A. is a leading public transport company based in Bologna, Italy, specializing in the organization and management of local public transportation services, including bus, rail, tram, and cable-car operations. Established in 2012 through the merger of ATC Trasporti and Fer Trasporti, TPER is dedicated to enhancing mobility solutions in the Emilia-Romagna region, particularly in urban areas like Bologna and Ferrara. The company's mission is to provide efficient, safe, and sustainable transport services that meet the diverse needs of its passengers while promoting environmental responsibility. TPER serves a wide range of clients, including local municipalities, regional authorities, daily commuters, tourists, and residents who rely on its services for their transportation needs. The company operates an extensive bus network with 324 lines and has seen significant ridership recovery, serving approximately 150.7 million passengers in 2023. TPER collaborates with various stakeholders, including Trenitalia and local authorities, to deliver integrated transport solutions and innovative mobility initiatives, such as electric vehicle sharing. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, TPER continuously invests in fleet modernization and infrastructure improvements to enhance service delivery. The company operates under public service obligations, ensuring that transport services remain accessible and affordable, even in economically challenging situations. TPER's vision is to foster sustainable transport solutions that contribute positively to the quality of life and environmental conditions in the communities it serves. By integrating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) principles into its operations, TPER aims to address the evolving needs of urban mobility while ensuring a reliable and efficient transport network for all users. Through its strategic initiatives and partnerships, TPER S.p.A. plays a vital role in the development of regional transport infrastructure, positioning itself as a key player in the public transport sector in Italy.

Name: AMT
Company description: AMT is a public company owned by the Municipality of Genoa and the Metropolitan City, responsible for the planning, management, and commercialization of multimodal transport services (road, rail, cable, and maritime) within the metropolitan area of Genoa. The company is dedicated to implementing the Sustainable Mobility Plan and innovating transport solutions and technologies to enhance urban mobility. AMT aims to excel in its responsibilities, focusing on providing clean and orderly communities where waste is viewed as recoverable materials to be transformed and reintegrated into the production cycle sustainably. Its clientele includes local residents and businesses, while its partnerships extend to various public and private entities involved in urban development and environmental sustainability. The target market encompasses the entire metropolitan area, including over 30 municipalities in the Liguria region, reflecting AMT's commitment to regional and interregional circular economy initiatives.

Name: Captrain Italia
HQ Location: Italy, Milano, Assago, Viale Milanofiori Strada 3, 20090
Company description: Captrain Italia è la filiale italiana del Gruppo SNCF focalizzata sul trasporto ferroviario delle merci.  Il Gruppo SNCF, controllato dallo Stato francese, con 202.000 impiegati in 120 nazioni costituisce un punto di riferimento per la mobilità e la logistica a livello mondiale. Il Gruppo si focalizza su due importanti attività: Infrastruttura e Servizi. Captrain Italia si posiziona sul mercato nazionale ed internazionale proponendo soluzioni e servizi personalizzati per i traffici ferroviari merci, sia combinati che convenzionali. Nata in Italia nel 1998 come società di rappresentanza commerciale, Captrain Italia ha ottenuto la licenza ferroviaria ed il certificato di sicurezza nel 2006, divenendo la prima filiale del gruppo SNCF in Europa ad operare come impresa ferroviaria.  Captrain Italia costituisce un tassello importante nella rete europea del Gruppo che garantisce una copertura capillare ai Clienti internazionali. L’affidabilità dei traffici europei è favorita dell’utilizzo di locomotive interoperabili e da prestazioni logistiche svolte nel pieno rispetto della sicurezza delle persone, delle merci e dell’ambiente. Grazie alla presenza di un reticolo di unità locali in continuo sviluppo (tra cui Milano, Torino, Genova, Trieste, Ventimiglia, Modena, Verona, Pescara, Modane, Treviso), ad una flotta di vagoni e locomotive e soprattutto ad uno staff altamente specializzato e motivato, Captrain Italia offre soluzioni competitive a livello nazionale ed internazionale su tutti gli assi alpini.  Il centro logistico Cargo Docks di Modena, l’officina Tiber.co specializzata nella manutenzione del materiale rotabile ad Asti e la società di manovre Cargo Rail Italy completano il presidio della catena del valore al servizio dei Clienti.

Name: Samer & Co. Shipping
Company description: Samer & Co. Shipping today is a leading company in shipping and forwarding, with over 600 employees and overseas companies in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Hungary, Montenegro, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Turkiye.  Established back in 1919, it is headquartered in Trieste, whose port is known as the gateway to Europe, and offers services covering four business areas:  1. Ship agents & brokers for liner and tramp vessels, cruise ships, mega yachts, providing assistance to crew, vessel clearance, dry-docking operations, and acting as General Agents for the most important Mediterranean Sea Highway, connecting Europe and Turkey. 2. Port terminal operators in the Customs Free Port of Trieste, specializing in ro-ro vessels, intermodal trains, heavy lifts, project cargoes and reefer goods. 3. International freight forwarders: As FIATA and IATA agents, Samer provides turnkey solutions, from the sea/air/land freight, groupage, storage (general and reefer), to the door-to-door delivery, worldwide. It also specializes in heavy lifts and project cargoes, owns logistic warehouses and gives assistance as customs broker and providing cargo insurance.  4. Claims settling agents, Lloyd’s of London agents since 1932, P&I correspondents for the most prestigious clubs, performing surveys and inspections with own personnel.  P.I: IT00047110325

Name: SETA S.p.A.
Company description: SETA S.p.A. is a prominent public transport operator in Italy, specifically serving the provinces of Modena, Reggio Emilia, and Piacenza. Established on January 1, 2012, through the merger of several local transport companies, SETA has become a key player in the public transport sector, providing essential bus and trolleybus services to over 1.5 million residents across a territory of 7,565 square kilometers. The company's mission is to enhance the quality of life in the communities it serves by ensuring accessible, efficient, and environmentally sustainable transport solutions. SETA is committed to continuous improvement and innovation, investing significantly in fleet modernization and advanced technologies to enhance service quality and safety. The company serves a diverse clientele, including daily commuters, students, and individuals with disabilities, ensuring that public transport remains a viable and attractive option for all. SETA collaborates closely with local authorities and mobility agencies to align its services with regional needs, integrating its operations with regional rail networks for seamless travel. With a strong emphasis on sustainability, SETA has implemented eco-friendly practices, including the use of hydrogen and electric vehicles, to reduce carbon emissions and improve urban livability. SETA also prioritizes employee welfare and development, offering comprehensive training programs and initiatives to support social inclusion, particularly for marginalized groups. The company actively engages with local communities and partners, fostering job opportunities and promoting responsible public transport usage. Through its commitment to transparency, customer engagement, and corporate social responsibility, SETA aims to position itself as a leader in sustainable public transport solutions in the Emilia-Romagna region.

Name: Gruppo Spinelli
Company description: Il Gruppo Spinelli è dal 1963 sinonimo di logistica, grazie alla sua presenza diffusa e capillare su tutto il territorio nazionale. Le business units del Gruppo permettono di offrire servizi integrati che rispondono alle esigenze di tutta la filiera logistica: terminal portuale, trasporto intermodale, camionistico, warehousing, aree di deposito, riparazione, compravendita container ed operazioni doganali.  L’attività storica del Gruppo è quella del trasporto su gomma che si svolge nelle basi operative di Genova, Padova, Livorno, Milano (Arluno), La Spezia (Santo Stefano Magra) e Reggio Emilia (Dinazzano) e si avvale di oltre 600 mezzi di proprietà.  I centri intermodali di Reggio Emilia, Padova e Milano movimentano ogni anno circa treni che trasportano le merci verso i più importanti porti italiani: Genova, Livorno e La Spezia, dove sono localizzate altre strutture intermodali di proprietà.  La divisione GPT del Gruppo Spinelli opera nel Porto di Genova offrendo servizi di imbarco/sbarco di containers, ro-ro e merce varia e movimentando annualmente volumi superiori ai 500.000 TEUs. Le recenti acquisizioni di quote di Terminal Rinfuse Genova Srl e di Salerno Container Terminal-SCT S.p.a, hanno ulteriormente sviluppato la divisione terminal. La divisione Depositi offre attività di riparazione, deposito, movimentazione e compravendita containers. Tale attività è svolta in strutture presenti presso i terminal interni di Milano (Arluno), Reggio Emilia (Dinazzano), Vignole Borbera, La Spezia, Livorno e nel porto di Genova e di Genova Pra’-Voltri.  Centro Servizi Derna srl e Consorzio Genova Distripark di Prà-Voltri si occupano dell’attività di warehousing, trasporti convenzionali ed eccezionali, depositi nazionali doganali e merci varie, imballaggi industriali. Saimare S.p.A. opera nel settore delle spedizioni con una presenza diretta nei principali porti italiani, tra cui Genova, Savona Vado, La Spezia, Napoli, Livorno, Cagliari e Gioia Tauro.

Name: Trenitalia Tper
Company description: Due nomi una sola società: Trenitalia Tper (70% Trenitalia 30% Tper) è la nuova impresa ferroviaria che si è aggiudicata la gara europea, bandita dalla Regione Emilia Romagna, per la gestione del trasporto ferroviario regionale. Con oltre 1450 dipendenti e la flotta di treni regionali più giovane d’Italia, garantisce ogni giorno 900 collegamenti: un’offerta capillare che copre tutta la regione con alcune estensioni Lombardia, Liguria, Piemonte, Veneto e Marche. Fino a 165mila persone trasportate giornalmente.

Name: Brescia Mobilità SpA
Company description: Brescia Mobilità SpA is a key player in the transportation sector, focusing on the development and management of urban mobility solutions in Brescia, Italy. The company is dedicated to providing efficient and sustainable public transport services, including buses and trams, to enhance the quality of life for residents and visitors alike. With a mission to promote environmentally friendly transportation options, Brescia Mobilità SpA aims to reduce carbon emissions and improve urban mobility through innovative solutions. The company collaborates with various partners, including Alstom and Hitachi Rail, to implement advanced technologies and infrastructure projects that support its vision of a connected and sustainable urban environment. Its target market includes local commuters, tourists, and businesses that rely on efficient public transport systems.

Name: Intermodaltrasporti
Company description: Our company was founded in 1987 by Pietro Fiorini and today is the leader of a group of companies operating in integrated logistics and multimodal transport. Among the most competitive companies in Europe, we work integrating road, rail and sea transport, using upstream and downstream warehouses and terminals for storage and transit time of goods. The choice of intermodal management allows us to offer logistics solutions that are efficient in terms of time, cost and eco-sustainability. The continuous process of growth and innovation, the international vocation, the use of highly qualified resources, the exclusive service level and the substantial specific investments in the sector make us a competitive, solid and reliable reality. Our mission is to create highly innovative and reliable solutions, customer-oriented in compliance with high-quality standards for all services offered. Through high-level partnerships with Europe's leading rail and maritime operators and thanks to our thirty years of experience in the field, we are able to offer quality, environmentally friendly freight traffic management that meets all customer needs. A solid logistics network and a large fleet of bulk and tank containers allow us to plan for the same shipment the ideal combination of different modes. The standardised loading units adapt to the technical and specific needs of the different types of transport, guaranteeing an efficient traffic system with a considerable reduction in the impact on the environment. Our company carries out its activities in an environmentally friendly way, minimizing CO2 emissions and making rail and sea transport the main vectors of use. Today we transport about 80% of our goods by rail and ship.

Name: Smet
Company description: SMET, led by CEO Cav. Domenico De Rosa, is a prominent player in the logistics and transportation sector, specializing in road, rail, and maritime services. The company is committed to enhancing road safety and promoting responsible driving behaviors, as evidenced by its support for the recent reforms to the Codice della Strada aimed at increasing penalties for dangerous driving and improving regulations for new drivers and electric scooters. SMET's mission revolves around fostering a culture of safety and responsibility among road users, particularly the youth, through education and proactive measures rather than solely punitive actions. The company collaborates with public and private sectors to improve infrastructure and implement advanced technologies, ensuring a comprehensive approach to road safety. SMET serves a diverse clientele, including individuals, businesses, and governmental organizations, all of whom benefit from its expertise in logistics and commitment to sustainable practices.

Name: CFI - Compagnia Ferroviaria Italiana S.P.A
Company description: CFI nasce nel 2007, dalla iniziativa dell'Amministratore Delegato Giacomo di Patrizi e da un gruppo di imprenditori privati che hanno creduto nelle potenzialità del trasporto ferroviario ed hanno deciso di investire in questo settore. In pochi anni CFI ha saputo ritagliarsi un ruolo di primo piano nel trasporto ferroviario, raggiungendo una quota di mercato del trasporto merci di tutto rispetto che la colloca ai primi posti tra le imprese ferroviarie private. Tutto ciò grazie ad una copertura operativa capillare del territorio nazionale, che ha permesso a CFI di raggiungere i piu importanti clienti, i distretti industriali, i porti e i terminal intermodali Italiani. Ad oggi, siamo la principale azienda ferroviaria italiana a capitale completamente privato. Offriamo ai nostri clienti servizi di trasporto ferroviario affidabili, flessibili ed al giusto prezzo.  Abbiamo una flotta di 600 carri ferroviari e un parco locomotive Siemens nuovissime.

Name: Umbria TPL E Mobilità
Company description: Umbriamobilità born from the fusion of the previous 4 trasport company operating on the region: FCU, SSIT, ATC and APM. The FCU Operate on Train, around al the Umbria region, SSIT operate around Spoleto, ATC operate around Terni; Apm operate around Perugia. Apm manage also ships on the trasimeno lake. FCU differently from the other companys offer public trasport with train.

Name: Trentino Trasporti S.p.A.
Company description: Trentino Trasporti S.p.A. is a public transportation company based in Trentino, Italy, specializing in the operation of buses, trains, and cable cars, including the Trento-Malé-Mezzana railway. The company is committed to providing high-quality transport services that are accessible to all, including special provisions for individuals with disabilities and cyclists. Its mission focuses on enhancing mobility within the region while ensuring customer satisfaction and safety. Trentino Trasporti collaborates with various local authorities and organizations to deliver essential public transport services, catering to a diverse clientele that includes students, workers, and tourists. The company is also dedicated to transparency and ethical governance, as evidenced by its comprehensive policies and agreements aimed at improving employee conditions and service quality.

Name: Rail Traction Company
Company description: Rail Traction Company SpA (RTC) is a private railway company founded in February 2000 in order to exploit the opportunities arising from the liberalization of the rail transport market in Italy and Europe. Rail Traction Company was the first private company to provide a freight service along the Brenner axis. RTC guarantees rail transport services to logistics and freight operators who organise complete trains both in the sector of intermodal freight transport (containers, swap bodies, semi-trailers) and conventional transport. Bolzano and Verona are the crucial nodes of national and international rail traffic and they are the home respectively of the registered office and the operative headquarters of the company.

Name: Naar Bespoke Travel
Company description: Naar Bespoke Tavel è un tour operator con sede a Milano specializzato in viaggi su misura e pacchetti dinamici fondata nel 1996 da Frederic Naar.  Fin dagli albori, NAAR si è contraddistinto sul mercato per la componente tecnologica a servizio delle agenzie di viaggio, il supporto professionale del team, l’attenzione ai dettagli e la selezione di partner di qualità.  Nel panorama italiano si conferma come il punto di riferimento per la costruzione di viaggi su misura, viaggi di nozze, fly & drive, fly & train, viaggi multi-destinazione, in Nord e Sud America, Caraibi, Messico, Europa, Penisola Arabica, Africa, Oceano Indiano, Asia, Oceania e Oceano Pacifico.  Tradizionale ma con spirito innovativo, NAAR declina l'eleganza e l’esperienza in viaggi su misura di medio e alto profilo, e per adattarsi alle tendenze del settore e anticipare le esigenze dei viaggiatori rinnova costantemente l'esclusivo software che rende il processo di creazione dei viaggi semplice, veloce ed intuitivo. La sinergia di esperti product manager, team di prenotazione, programmatori e un’ampia rete vendite, fa di NAAR uno dei più rinomati ed affidabili tour operator italiani.  La sede centrale è a Milano, con filiali operative a Roma, Napoli e Palermo, mentre dal 2019 ha esteso il suo modello di business al mercato francese, e dal 2024 ha aperto in Germania e in Benelux.

Name: Itabus
Company description: Itabus S.p.A. is a prominent Italian bus transportation company that operates a comprehensive network of over 2,200 daily connections across the country, catering to both domestic and international travelers. Established under the direction of Italo – Nuovo Trasporto Viaggiatori S.p.A., Itabus aims to enhance mobility and accessibility by providing high-quality, comfortable, and eco-friendly travel options. The company focuses on connecting major cities and popular tourist destinations, particularly during peak travel seasons, thereby supporting the growth of Italy's tourism industry. Itabus serves a diverse clientele, including tourists, business travelers, and individuals with reduced mobility, and collaborates with various partners to offer intermodal travel solutions that integrate bus and train services. With a commitment to safety, comfort, and sustainability, Itabus continues to expand its services and improve the travel experience for its customers.

Name: Italy Car Rent
Company description: Italy Car Rent is a dynamic car rental company based in Bolzano, Italy, dedicated to providing efficient and customer-focused vehicle rental services. The company’s mission is to simplify the car rental experience, offering a wide range of vehicles that cater to various travel needs, from compact city cars to spacious SUVs. With operations in 15 locations across major airports and train stations in Italy, Italy Car Rent ensures convenient pick-up and drop-off directly at terminals, enhancing the overall travel experience for its clients.  The company prioritizes customer satisfaction and data protection, adhering to GDPR regulations to safeguard the privacy and security of its clients' personal information. Targeting both leisure and business travelers, Italy Car Rent aims to deliver a seamless rental process characterized by competitive pricing and exceptional service. Its diverse fleet includes popular models such as the Opel Mokka, Fiat Panda, and Toyota Yaris, ensuring that clients can easily find the right vehicle for their journey. Italy Car Rent caters to a wide range of clients, including tourists exploring Italy's beautiful landscapes and attractions, as well as business travelers requiring reliable transportation. The company operates at key locations, including Bergamo and Olbia airports, providing convenient access to vehicles. Committed to excellent service, Italy Car Rent offers 24/7 assistance, transparent pricing with no hidden costs, and comprehensive insurance coverage, making it a trusted choice for those looking to rent a car in Italy. Through its dedication to quality and customer care, Italy Car Rent continues to grow as a preferred option for travelers seeking hassle-free and affordable car rental solutions.

Name: T&T
HQ Location: Italy, Campania, Naples, 1 Via Vicinale S. Maria Del Pianto Complesso Polifunzionale Inail Torre, 80143
Company description: T&T (Technology & Transportation) nasce a Napoli nel 2007, ereditando le competenze e le conoscenze di dominio di professionisti con notevole seniority sia nel settore dell’Information & Communication Technology sia in ambito trasporti, in particolare in attività di consulenza e supporto nella verifica e validazione dei sistemi ferroviari (SCMT Sistema di controllo della marcia del treno, e ERTMS European Rail Traffic Management System), nell’analisi e gestione del rischio, nella definizione dei requisiti RAMS, nelle metodologie di sviluppo di applicazioni “safety e mission critical”.  L’organico aziendale è formato da 50 ingegneri altamente qualificati, che garantiscono  elevati standard qualitativi e professionali sia nel consulting sia in laboratorio. In ambito ferroviario, T&T offre i suoi servizi sia alle Aziende Produttrici di Sistemi Ferroviari sia agli Enti di Trasporto, pubblico e privati, gestori di tali Sistemi.  L’azienda opera, inoltre, nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di soluzioni informatiche ad alto valore tecnologico, nell’automazione industriale e nella formazione del personale.

Name: Albatravel
Company description: Albatravel is part of Worldwide Hotel Link Group and it is a European tour operator leader in the B2B market. With the assistance of our worldwide offices we provide the best service and assistance to more than 20,000 travel agencies registered on our platform albatravel.com with a a clear B2B strategy. Our mission is the distribution of the best tourist services (hotels, flights, trains, escorted tours, sightseeing, transfer) at the most competitive rates, using high and modern technologies. Our in-house technology allows all our content to be easily available via our platform, with the same simplicity and convenience that has always distinguished us. We look forward to a bright future ahead. Our values are our advanced and reliable technology, high profitability, a commercial flexibility and a 24/7 customer support service.

Name: GTS Rail
Company description: GTS Rail is the GTS group rail division, which has been operating in liberalized market since 2008. Its mission consists in providing high quality and efficiency traction services both for goods and for passengers. Today's "real" level of liberalization allows to provide services only for goods. GTS services are addressed to any kind of train and customer. GTS Rail aims at becoming a best practice in the railway world, which, unfortunately, is still characterised by the presence of public, semi-public, national and foreigner subjects. Efficiency and quality are at the basis of our operational model: they do not remain abstract concepts, rather they pervade our everyday work, values and corporate culture.  When thinking at railways, the ensuing image and sensation are negative, by definition, since many companies and people have experienced dramatic or even disastrous situations. GTS has the strong will to reverse the common idea of railways as a second-rate, low-quality and obsolete system. We operate in a 100-years-old market showing a great potential, which has not managed to express itself yet. Suffice it to think that only 4% of goods is transported by train, and the transport of people is inefficient. "GTS Rail perfectly knows which is the key factor to become a successful company. The railway world is characterised by an incredible passion: our aim is to let all of our co-workers express such passion. If we manage, this means we will have achieved our challenging goals".

Name: Paratori Genova
Company description: Paratori was established in 1973 and has decades of experience in the transport sector. We carry out transports at both a national and international level, with offices at both Genoa in Liguria and Olgiate Molgora near Milan Our fleet consists of euroliners, covered low loaders for the transport of steel and other static cargo, flat trailers, containers, swap bodies and refrigerated trailers. We are constantly expanding our fleet with newer equipment and different types of trailers, all of which means that we are able to offer a personalised service to all of our customers Thanks to our warehouse and overhead crane we are also able to offer storage and cargo management services Our intermodal department, offering transport via rail, sea and air, has had a huge impact on our reduction of the emission of CO2 and other greenhouse gases

Name: EVM RAIL
HQ Location: Italy, Veneto, Verona, 17 Via Della Scienza, 37139
Company description: EVM Rail intende sviluppare e promuovere servizi ferroviari e ricercare nuove soluzioni di trasporto su rotaia da offrire ai propri clienti come alternativa vantaggiosa ed ecologica alle altre forme di trasporto, come per esempio quello su gomma. EVM Rail si propone come un’Impresa Ferroviaria estremamente snella, focalizzata e notevolmente specializzata nella produzione di treni tradizionali completi trasportanti merci rappresentate prevalentemente da materie prime (come per esempio i cereali, il ferro, ecc.), senza escludere dal proprio business la possibilità di effettuare il trasporto intermodale di unità di traffico combinato (contenitori, semirimorchi stradali ecc). EVM Rail è in grado di offrire ai propri clienti, grazie all’esperienza pluriennale dei propri esperti ferroviari, servizi di consulenza con l’obiettivo ricercare nuove sinergie e soluzioni innovative.

Name: Avis Autonoleggio Italia
Company description: Avis Autonoleggio Italia, part of the Avis Budget Group, is a leading car rental company in Italy, offering a comprehensive range of vehicles to meet the needs of both private and business clients. The company's mission is to provide high-quality service, ensuring flexibility and transparency in pricing, with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction. Avis stands out with its loyalty program, Avis Preferred, which rewards frequent customers with exclusive benefits and discounts. The clientele of Avis includes individual travelers, families, and corporate clients, reflecting its ability to cater to a diverse audience. Strategic partnerships with airports and train stations enhance accessibility to rental services throughout the country, making it easier for customers to find and rent vehicles. With over 10,250 locations in Italy and worldwide, Avis Autonoleggio Italia is dedicated to making the car rental experience simple and convenient for everyone. The company aims to enhance mobility and travel experiences while prioritizing safety and reliability, ensuring that clients can trust Avis for their transportation needs. Through its commitment to exceptional service and customer care, Avis continues to solidify its position as a leader in the car rental industry.

Name: DN Logistica Srl
HQ Location: Italy, Sicily, Catania, Via Filippo Anfuso, 95121
Company description: DN Logistica è un’azienda di trasporto merci intermodale, trasporto merci su strada e logistica integrata, con base in Sicilia e attiva da decenni su tutto il territorio nazionale. DN Logistica, inoltre, è l’unica azienda siciliana a disporre di un moderno polo logistico ferroviario privato, a ridosso dello scalo merci di Catania-Bicocca e con grandi magazzini dedicati alla movimentazione delle merci in arrivo nel terminal: una grande novità per il mercato della logistica  in Sicilia, con notevoli vantaggi di tempi e di costo per i clienti. Company description: La società Interporto Campano S.p.A., a capitale interamente privato, è concessionaria della Regione Campania fino al 2080 per la progettazione, costruzione e gestione dell’interporto nel sito di Nola. Hub strategico del trasporto merci internazionale, è una delle principali strutture logistiche intermodali in Italia che offre un sistema di trasporto combinato (ferro, gomma, aria e mare), integrando stoccaggio, movimentazione e manipolazione delle merci. L’attuale superficie è occupata da 500.000 mq di magazzini condotti da circa 200 aziende tra operatori industriali, distributori, logistici, spedizionieri e corrieri di livello internazionale. Il complesso è direttamente collegato alla rete stradale nazionale e regionale. È immediatamente raggiungibile attraverso l’Autostrada A16 Napoli – Bari, A30 Caserta – Salerno, A1 Milano – Napoli e A3 Salerno – Reggio Calabria. L’area in cui è situato presenta collegamenti ottimali con i più importanti nodi ferroviari, marittimi ed aeroportuali. Nel 1976 il Piano Generale dei Trasporti prevede la realizzazione di un interporto nell’aerea di sviluppo industriale Nola-Marigliano a 30 chilometri da Napoli. Gli imprenditori napoletani, che avevano dato vita al CIS, intuirono l’opportunità e si fecero promotori della realizzazione dell’Interporto di Nola, costituendo la società Interporto Campano SpA e ricevendo nel 1989 dalla Regione Campania la concessione fino al 2080 per la progettazione, costruzione e gestione della piattaforma logistica. Nel 1991 vengono avviati i lavori e i primi lotti vengono inaugurati nel 1998. Il 1999 sancisce la piena operatività ferroviaria e intermodale con l’arrivo del primo treno merci in Interporto. Nel 2003 Interporto Campano acquisisce nuove superfici e nel 2011 viene completato il primo lotto della fase di “Ampliamento”. Nel 2018, l’Interporto di Nola entra far parte del perimetro della ZES (Zona Economica Speciale) Campana.

Company description: Every day thousands of tons of goods of all types cross our borders, moving by road, rail, water or air. Our customs specialists declare over 70,000 shipments per year which cross the Italian Swiss border, both for imports and exports. The execution of customs formalities are doing at inland customs desk and our clearing crew are supported by the most modern IT systems having a direct connection with customs. A fitting technological development, given the considerable increase in international traffic in the last few years. Franzosini represents a reference for the international market, with highly prepared customs declarants at its offices since 1929. Appointing to a customs specialist in daily practices, is a specific requirement of the clients so that everything will be checked and cleared in the right way. In opposite could be happened that an incorrect or hasty declaration can lead to high customs charges, which sometimes reach relevant proportions without any responsibility to the freight forwarder. Franzosini favours practical solutions, has efficient structures, reduces waiting times preferring a simple, automated exchange of information between the client and the customs office. We are among the few companies which perform customs operations on a continuous basis and in the evening until 22:00h and we have also inland bonded warehouses located near to the border zones in which the formalities are carried out even if the main border crossing points are closed. In our bonded warehouses, we are enabled to hold goods with suspension of VAT and duties (Authorised consignor, Authorised consignee, Open customs warehouses (OCW).

Name: RailEvo
HQ Location: Italy, Trentino-alto Adige, Rovereto, 8 Via Fortunato Zeni, 38068
Company description: RailEvo is an innovative, autonomous, on-demand, non-stop rail transportation system. Vehicle A dual-mode, fully autonomous vehicle, capable of travelling fast and efficiently on rails and maneuvering in any direction on the station’s flat surfaces with additional mecanum-wheel. RailEvo is a fully autonomous system, sharing technologies already used for autonomous metro systems and AGVs ( Autonomous Guided Vehicles ) while travelling on rails and maneuver on the surface station respectively. Line Network RailEvo provides an on-demand and non-stop service between stations on a rail network. Some stations can be also used as nodes so that vehicles can autonomously change from one line to the other. Station Vehicles get into the station through the vertical rail switch. They deploy their mecanum wheels to move omnidirectionally to parking bays, where passengers can alight safely in their own time, away from the main traffic. Vehicle maneuvering speed in the station is about 5-6 km/h. The station  max capacity is about 600 vehicles/h or more. Traffic Capacity Very high traffic capacity despite the small infrastructure. Up to 1500 vehicle/h per direction. User Experience On-demand service 24/7: Since RailEvo vehicles are fully autonomous and can move independently on the network and at the stations; the service is personalized and can be offered any time 24/7 from any station to any other station on the network. Users are free to move around the RailEvo network whenever they want. This is an enormous improvement on current rail systems’ user experience, such that many more citizens will use rail instead of their private cars.

Company description: Free2go risponde ad una domanda ben precisa che le aziende si pongono da tempo: "Esiste un modo veloce, meno costoso e meno inquinante rispetto ai mezzi tradizionali, per permettere ai nostri lavoratori di spostarsi in autonomia?". La risposta di Free2go è ovviamente positiva: esiste, è comoda e sicura. Dal 2018 forniamo gli ultimi modelli di monopattini elettrici alle migliori aziende del territorio Milanese. Il vantaggio ricavato dall'utilizzo del monopattino è duplice: I nostri clienti sfruttano i monopattini per velocizzare e rendere più piacevole il tragitto casa-lavoro dei propri dipendenti, mai più quindi code al semaforo in automobile, decine di minuti spesi per cercare parcheggio e corse in autobus affollati. Due tipi di servizi sono offerti da Free2go: • Noleggio giornaliero: l'utente può noleggiare tramite l'app aziendale il mezzo, semplicemente prendendolo dalla postazione più vicina alla propria abitazione, lo utilizzerà fino al posto di lavoro, per poi fare il percorso inverso; • Noleggio per più giorni: tramite l'app dell'azienda, l'utente stabilisce di quanti giorni ha necessità di noleggiare il mezzo (ad esempio per tutta la settimana lavorativa, 5 giorni), a questo punto al suo ritorno a casa potrà portarlo nella sua abitazione come fosse di sua proprietà, riconsegnandolo l'ultimo giorno stabilito. È importante tenere a mente che Milano (come altre città italiane) sta ingrandendo sempre di più la rete delle piste pedonali e ciclabili, in entrambi i casi l'utilizzo dei monopattini elettrici è permesso, questo significa maggior sicurezza e velocità per il conducente. Da segnalare inoltre che nel caso l'utente utilizzi già dei mezzi di trasporto "classici", come il treno o la metropolitana, è possibile "imbarcare" il monopattino a bordo senza alcun problema. Il secondo importante vantaggio riguarda gli spostamenti interni dei dipendenti fra gli stabili e i magazzini, tempi di percorrenza più che dimezzati senza nessuna forma di inquinamento.
